nativeBodyCompositions.recommendedFullBody:
Permaculture yo thewa kha milayo miraru ya vhuḓifari. U Ṱhogomela Mavu na Mupo (Earth Care) zwi amba u dzhia mavu, maḓi, zwimela na zwipuka sa maitele a no tshila a fanelaho u tsireledzwa, hu si zwiko zwine zwa fanela u fhedzwa. U Ṱhogomela Vhathu (People Care) zwi amba uri ṱhoḓea dza muṱa waṋu dzi dzia u ranga, ha kona u tevhela dza tshitshavha tsha haṋu. U Kovhelana ho Fanelaho (Fair Share) zwi amba u dzhia fhedzi zwine na zwi ṱoḓa nahone na vhuedzedza zwo salaho (surplus) — mbeu, zwiḽiwa, maḓi, nḓivho — murahu kha maitele.

Hezwi a si mihumbulo fhedzi i sa vhonali. Mulimi ane a rengisa makumba oṱhe na miroho yoṱhe fhedzi a si siele ṱafula ḽa muṱa tshithu u khou pfuka u Ṱhogomela Vhathu. Tshitshavha tshine tsha thivhela tshisima tshi kovhelanwaho nga lufhenḓe tshi khou pwanya u Kovhelana ho Fanelaho.

Milayo ya vhuḓifari ndi ya ndeme ngauri i ni thusa u dzhia tsheo musi hu si na bugu ya milayo — muhura ane a khou humbela u fulisa kholomo nga murahu ha gomelelo, mandindi ane a khou tshinyadza dzi-swale dzaṋu. Fhaṱani hezwi zwiraru kha nḓila ine na humbula ngayo musi ni sa athu fhaṱa tshithu fhasi.

David Holmgren o vhea maitele a design a fumi na mavhili kha Essence of Permaculture. Bill Mollison na David Holmgren vho thoma muhumbulo wa permaculture vhoṱhe. Maitele mararu a vhuedzaho u thoma ngao kha hei ngudo ndi haya: observe and interact — sedzani land yaṋu kha khalaṅwaha yoṱhe ni sa athu ita major earthworks; catch and store energy — ṱhogomelani mvula, ḓuvha na biomass zwi sa athu bva kha ndaka yaṋu; na use edges and value the marginal — muduba wa fence kana tshipiḓa tshi re tsini na nḓila (strip) tshi nga vha fhethu hu vhuedzaho ha u sedza.

Maṅwe maitele ane zwa vhuedza u a ḓivha ndi haya: produce no waste (masalela a vha compost, compost ya vha mavu); use small and slow solutions (bakete ḽi nga sheledza planting bed hu si na muḓagasi); na use and value diversity. Hail injury kha maize i ya nga ḓumbu na growth stage ya crop.

Khethani maitele mavhili kana mararu ane a tshimbidzana na thaidzo yaṋu khulwanesa, nahone ni a shumise nga mafulufulu. Maṅwe a ḓo tou vha khagala musi ni tshi khou bvela phanḓa.

Zones na sectors zwi thusa u fhungudza mushumo u sa ṱoḓei. Zones dzi bva kha 0 u ya kha 5, zwi tshi tevhedza uri ni dalela fhethu honoho lunzhi-lini. Zone 0 ndi nnḓu. Kha tsumbo iyi, Zone 1 i tsini na nnḓu nahone i na zwine na zwi ka lunzhi — herbs na muroho wa saladi. Zone 2 ndi serapa tshihulwane na chicken run, zwine zwa dalelwa luthihi kana luvhili nga ḓuvha. Zone 3 ndi tsimu khulwane, ine ya dalelwa vhege iṅwe na iṅwe. Zone 4 ndi semi-wild — miri ya mitshelo na fodder zwine zwa ṱoḓa ṱhogomelo nga zwiṅwe zwifhinga. Zone 5 yo siwa i wild.

Sectors ndi energy dzi no swika dzi tshi bva nnḓa — ḓuvha, muya, mvula, mandindi na mulilo. Sedzani hune muya u re na maanḓa wa bva hone bulasini yaṋu. Rekhodo dza weather station ya tsini dzi nga thusa u sedza thungo ya muya. Sedzani hune maḓi a mvula a dzhena hone na hune a elela hone kha land yaṋu. Olani misevhe u sumbedza zwe na zwi vhona.

Olani zones na sectors kha bammbiri, nahone ni vha ni na motheo wa pulane yaṋu.

semanticFindings.accepted: The accepted content-level proposals retain the checked source predicates, numbers, conditions, sequence, OR/AND, negation, modal, timing, category and spatial relations. Two previously accepted candidate sentences are now marked repair solely for Tshivenda noun concord: ḽi with ḓumbu and mavhili/mararu with plural maitele.
semanticFindings.repairs: Seven repair rows remain. The principles sentence now carries class-6 agreement through numerals, relative pronoun, object pronoun and next sentence. The false quiz option preserves the source fragment “All animals kept off” verbatim and localizes only cultivated zone to avoid adding a subjunctive-style mood. Other precise repairs are detailed row by row.
semanticFindings.holds: Four precise spans should remain English: cost/work WITH benefit comparison, crops versus all plants, physical ground versus soil, and flood. Existing mandindi usage elsewhere is not independent lexical confirmation.
semanticFindings.inheritedCurrentTextRisks: The report preserves three source-meaning repairs: deck VE s11 body0 before they leave your property; deck VE s14 body1 edible crops return (now using the independently accepted return wording); and learner option VE L2 Q1 O3 all animals rather than possibly livestock/domestic animals. The full targets are in the rows.
semanticFindings.assessmentIdentity: The all-animals false distractor is actually Intro lesson L2 quiz index 1 option index 3; source correct index is 1. This identity is verified from the live canonical row; no index change proposed.
semanticFindings.limits: No fluent-speaker/local farming approval. Retaining an exact source span in English is a bounded precision hold; all other candidate translations are evaluated independently.

rows.exactSource: First find out if sharing is allowed. Check whether the borehole can serve all users without taking too much. If sharing is allowed and there is enough water, agree how to share fairly and keep watching the water level. People Care and Fair Share guide the agreement. Earth Care means protecting the source. Watching the level alone does not make extra use safe or allowed.
rows.exactCurrentVisibleTarget: Thomani nga u wana arali u kovhelana ho tendelwa. Check whether the borehole can serve all users without taking too much. Arali u kovhelana ho tendelwa nahone hu na maḓi o eḓanaho, tendelanani uri ni kovhelane nga ndinganyo ni dzule ni tshi sedza water level. People Care na Fair Share zwi livhisa u tendelana. Earth Care zwi amba u tsireledza the source. U sedza water level fhedzi a zwi ambi uri u shumisa maḓi o engedzeaho zwi safe kana zwo tendelwa.
rows.candidateFullTarget: Thomani nga u wana arali u kovhelana ho tendelwa. Ṱolani arali borehole i nga kona u shumela vhashumisi vhoṱhe hu si na u dzhia maḓi manzhi lwo kalaho. Arali u kovhelana ho tendelwa nahone hu na maḓi o eḓanaho, tendelanani uri ni kovhelane nga ndinganyo ni dzule ni tshi sedza vhuimo ha maḓi. People Care na Fair Share zwi livhisa u tendelana. Earth Care zwi amba u tsireledza tshiko. U sedza vhuimo ha maḓi fhedzi a zwi ambi uri u shumisa maḓi o engedzeaho zwi safe kana zwo tendelwa.

The chickens can clean up pests and add fertility instead of sitting idle in a fixed pen.
